  Calculate_Turbine_Risk_Score:
    title: Calculate Turbine Risk Score
    type: python
    description: >-
      Calculates weighted risk score from provider verdicts and determines risk verdict 

      based on thresholds
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
      code: "\"\"\"\nTurbine Risk Score Calculator\n\nThis script calculates a normalized risk score (0-1000) based on threat intelligence\nenrichments from multiple providers. Each provider's verdict is weighted according to\nits configured weight, and the final score is normalized to a scale of 0-1000.\n\nThe scoring system:\n- malicious: 2 points\n- suspicious: 1 point\n- benign: 0 points\n- unknown/error: Excluded from final score calculation but included in merged-risk-scores output\n\nAll enrichments are included in the merged-risk-scores output for display purposes,\nbut only valid scores (malicious, suspicious, benign) contribute to the final\nturbine-risk-score calculation.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\n# Mapping of threat intelligence verdicts to numeric scores\n# Scores range from 0 (benign) to 2 (malicious)\n# None values indicate verdicts that are excluded from final score calculation\n# but still included in merged-risk-scores output for display\nscore_mapping = {\n    \"malicious\": 2,\n    \"suspicious\": 1,\n    \"benign\": 0,\n    \"unknown\": None,  # Excluded from calculation, included in output\n    \"error\": None     # Excluded from calculation, included in output\n}\n\n# Array to store all score calculation elements\n# Each element represents a threat intelligence verdict with its metadata\nscore_calc = []\n\n# ============================================================================\n# PROVIDER WEIGHT CONFIGURATION\n# ============================================================================\n\n# Extract provider weights from threat_intelligence_providers configuration\n# This creates a lookup dictionary: provider_name -> weight\nprovider_weights = {}\nfor provider in action_inputs.get('threat_intelligence_providers', []):\n    provider_name = provider.get('Name', '')\n    provider_weight = provider.get('Weight', 0)\n    provider_weights[provider_name] = provider_weight\n\n# Get default weight to use when a provider is not found in the configuration\n# This ensures all enrichments have a weight, even if the provider isn't explicitly configured\ndefault_weight = 0\nfor provider in action_inputs.get('threat_intelligence_providers', []):\n    if provider.get('Name') == 'Default':\n        default_weight = provider.get('Weight', 0)\n        break\n\n# ============================================================================\n# SCORE PROCESSING FUNCTIONS\n# ============================================================================\n\ndef process(name, value, max_value, weight, description, data_type, verdict):\n    \"\"\"\n    Add a score element to the score_calc array.\n    \n    Args:\n        name: Name of the score element (typically provider name)\n        value: Numeric score value (0-2 for threat intelligence)\n        max_value: Maximum possible value for this score type (2 for threat intelligence)\n        weight: Weight multiplier for this provider's contribution\n        description: Human-readable description of the score\n        data_type: Type of enrichment (e.g., 'reputation', 'malware', etc.)\n    \"\"\"\n    score_calc.append(\n        {\n            \"name\": name,\n            \"value\": value,\n            \"max_value\": max_value,\n            \"weight\": weight,\n            \"description\": description,\n            \"type\": data_type,\n            \"verdict\": verdict\n        }\n    )\n\n# ============================================================================\n# PROCESS ENRICHMENTS\n# ============================================================================\n\n# Process each enrichment from action_inputs\n# Each enrichment represents a threat intelligence verdict from a provider\n# CRITICAL: ALL enrichments must be processed and included in merged-risk-scores output\nenrichments = action_inputs.get('enrichments', [])\nfor enrichment in enrichments:\n    provider_name = enrichment.get('enrichment_provider', '')\n    verdict = enrichment.get('enrichment_verdict', '').lower()  # Normalize to lowercase\n    enrichment_type = enrichment.get('enrichment_type', 'reputation')\n    \n    # Get weight for this provider, or use default weight if provider not found\n    weight = provider_weights.get(provider_name, default_weight)\n    \n    # Map verdict string to numeric score value\n    # Returns None for 'unknown' or 'error' verdicts, or if verdict is not in mapping\n    # If verdict is empty or not found, score_value will be None\n    # ALL enrichments are processed and included in merged-risk-scores output\n    score_value = score_mapping.get(verdict)  # Returns None if verdict not in mapping\n    \n    # Process ALL enrichments (including None values) for display in merged-risk-scores\n    # None values will be excluded from final score calculation but MUST be included in output\n    max_value = 2\n    name = f\"{provider_name}\"\n    # Handle empty or missing verdict gracefully for display\n    verdict_display = verdict if verdict else \"no verdict\"\n    description = f\"{provider_name}: {verdict_display}\"\n    data_type = enrichment_type\n    \n    # Add this enrichment to the score calculation array\n    # Note: score_value may be None for:\n    #   - 'unknown' or 'error' verdicts (explicitly mapped to None)\n    #   - Verdicts not in the score_mapping dictionary\n    #   - Empty or missing verdict strings\n    # This ensures ALL enrichments are included in the output, regardless of verdict value\n    process(name, score_value, max_value, weight, description, data_type, verdict)\n\n# ============================================================================\n# SCORE NORMALIZATION FUNCTIONS\n# ============================================================================\n\ndef get_merged_scores():\n    \"\"\"\n    Retrieve all score calculation elements.\n    \n    Returns:\n        List of score dictionaries containing all processed enrichments\n    \"\"\"\n    return score_calc\n\n\ndef normalize_score(value, max_value, max_normalized_value):\n    \"\"\"\n    Normalize a score to a given maximum value using cross multiplication.\n    \n    Formula: normalized = (value * max_normalized_value) / max_value\n    \n    Args:\n        value: The score value to normalize\n        max_value: The maximum possible value for the input score\n        max_normalized_value: The maximum value for the normalized output (e.g., 1000)\n    \n    Returns:\n        Normalized score value, rounded to nearest integer\n    \"\"\"\n    if max_value > 0:\n        normalized_value = round((value * max_normalized_value) / max_value)\n    else:\n        normalized_value = 0\n    return normalized_value\n\n\ndef get_normalized_score():\n    \"\"\"\n    Calculate the final normalized risk score (0-1000) from all enrichments.\n    \n    The calculation process:\n    1. For each score with a valid value (not None), calculate weighted_value = (value / max_value) * weight\n    2. Sum all weighted_values to get total_value (excluding None values)\n    3. Sum all weights for valid scores to get total_max_value\n    4. Normalize total_value/total_max_value to a 0-1000 scale\n    \n    Note: Scores with None values (unknown/error) are excluded from the calculation\n    but still included in the processed_scores output for display purposes.\n    \n    Returns:\n        Tuple of (normalized_score, processed_scores):\n        - normalized_score: Final risk score (0-1000) or None if all enrichments are unknown/error\n        - processed_scores: List of detailed score breakdowns for ALL enrichments (including None values)\n    \"\"\"\n    scores = get_merged_scores()\n    \n    # Handle empty scores case - return zero score with empty breakdown\n    if not scores:\n        return (0, [])\n    \n    # Calculate weighted contributions from scores with valid values (exclude None)\n    # Only scores with non-None values contribute to the final risk score\n    # IMPORTANT: All scores (including None values) will be included in the output\n    total_value = 0      # Sum of all weighted score values (excluding None)\n    total_max_value = 0  # Sum of all weights for valid scores (used as denominator for normalization)\n    \n    # First pass: Initialize weighted_value for all scores and calculate totals for valid scores\n    for score in scores:\n        weight = score.get('weight', 0)\n        max_value = score.get('max_value', 0)\n        value = score.get('value')\n        verdict = score.get('verdict')\n        \n        # Handle scores with None values - they don't contribute to the final score\n        # but MUST be included in the output for display\n        if value is None:\n            score['weighted_value'] = None  # Explicitly mark as excluded from calculation\n            # Continue to next score - this one won't affect the final score calculation\n            continue\n        \n        # Calculate weighted value: normalize score to 0-1, then multiply by weight\n        # This gives each provider's contribution proportional to its weight\n        if max_value > 0:\n            weighted_value = (value / max_value) * weight\n        else:\n            weighted_value = 0\n        \n        # Add to totals only for valid (non-None) scores\n        total_value += weighted_value\n        total_max_value += weight\n        score['weighted_value'] = weighted_value  # Store for later use in breakdown\n\n    # Normalize the total weighted score to 0-1000 scale\n    # This is the final risk score (only includes valid scores, excludes None values)\n    if total_max_value > 0:\n        normalized_value = normalize_score(total_value, total_max_value, 1000)\n    else:\n        # If no valid scores (all enrichments are unknown/error), return None\n        # This indicates that no valid threat intelligence data was available\n        normalized_value = None\n\n    # Build detailed breakdown of each score element for output\n    # CRITICAL: Include ALL scores (even those with None values) for display in merged-risk-scores\n    # This ensures the table shows all enrichments, regardless of whether they contribute to the score\n    processed_scores = []\n    for score in scores:\n        # Process every single score - no filtering or exclusion here\n        new_score = {}\n        weight = score.get('weight', 0)\n        value = score.get('value')  # May be None for unknown/error/unmapped verdicts\n        weighted_value = score.get('weighted_value')  # Will be None if value was None\n        max_value = score.get('max_value', 0)\n        verdict = score.get('verdict')\n        \n        # Format score details for output - include all fields for all scores\n        new_score['Value'] = value  # May be None for unknown/error verdicts\n        new_score['Max Value'] = max_value\n        new_score['Weight'] = weight\n        new_score['Turbine Risk Score Element Name'] = score['name']\n        new_score['Description'] = score['description']\n        new_score['Type'] = score['type']\n        \n        # Format raw score display - handle None values gracefully\n        if value is not None:\n            # new_score['Raw Score'] = f\"{value}/{max_value}\"\n            new_score['Raw Score'] = verdict\n        else:\n            new_score['Raw Score'] = \"N/A\"\n        \n        # Normalize each individual weighted value to 0-1000 for comparison\n        # Scores with None values will have None for normalized score (excluded from calculation)\n        if weighted_value is not None and total_max_value > 0:\n            new_score['Normalized Score'] = normalize_score(\n                weighted_value, total_max_value, 1000)\n        else:\n            new_score['Normalized Score'] = None  # Excluded from calculation but included in output\n        \n        # Append ALL scores to the output list - no exceptions\n        processed_scores.append(new_score)\n\n    return (normalized_value, processed_scores)\n\n# ============================================================================\n# CALCULATE FINAL SCORES\n# ============================================================================\n\n# Calculate the final normalized risk score and detailed breakdown\nnormalized_score, merged_scores = get_normalized_score()\n\n\ndef calculate_risk_verdict(score, thresholds):\n    \"\"\"\n    Calculate the risk verdict based on the normalized score and thresholds.\n    \n    Args:\n        score: The normalized risk score (0-1000) or None if all enrichments are unknown/error\n        thresholds: Dictionary with threshold values for Malicious, Suspicious, and Benign\n    \n    Returns:\n        String verdict: \"Malicious\", \"Suspicious\", \"Benign\", or \"Unknown\"\n    \"\"\"\n    # If score is None, all enrichments were unknown/error - return \"Unknown\"\n    if score is None:\n        return \"Unknown\"\n    \n    malicious_threshold = thresholds.get('Malicious', 600)\n    suspicious_threshold = thresholds.get('Suspicious', 300)\n    benign_threshold = thresholds.get('Benign', 0)\n    \n    # Determine verdict based on score thresholds (highest to lowest)\n    if score >= malicious_threshold:\n        return \"Malicious\"\n    elif score >= suspicious_threshold:\n        return \"Suspicious\"\n    elif score >= benign_threshold:\n        return \"Benign\"\n    else:\n        return \"Unknown\"\n\n\n# Get thresholds from action_inputs\nthresholds = action_inputs.get('turbine_risk_score_thresholds', {\n    'Malicious': 600,\n    'Suspicious': 300,\n    'Benign': 0\n})\n\n# Calculate the risk verdict based on the normalized score\nrisk_verdict = calculate_risk_verdict(normalized_score, thresholds)\n\n# Prepare output for the action\n# Note: json.dumps() preserves None values as 'null' in JSON, so all scores (including None values)\n# will be included in the merged-risk-scores output\naction_outputs = {\n    # JSON string of all score elements with detailed breakdown\n    # Includes ALL scores, even those with None values (unknown/error verdicts)\n    'merged-risk-scores': json.dumps(merged_scores, indent=2),\n    # Final normalized risk score (0-1000) or None if all enrichments are unknown/error\n    'turbine-risk-score': normalized_score,\n    # Risk verdict based on score thresholds: \"Malicious\", \"Suspicious\", \"Benign\", or \"Unknown\"\n    'risk-score-verdict': risk_verdict,\n}"
      inputs:
        enrichments:
          $:ref: $actions.Aggregate_Enrichments.result.enrichments
        threat_intelligence_providers:

        turbine_risk_score_thresholds:

        }

inputs.code:
"""
Turbine Risk Score Calculator

This script calculates a normalized risk score (0-1000) based on threat intelligence
enrichments from multiple providers. Each provider's verdict is weighted according to
its configured weight, and the final score is normalized to a scale of 0-1000.

The scoring system:
- malicious: 2 points
- suspicious: 1 point
- benign: 0 points
- unknown/error: Excluded from final score calculation but included in merged-risk-scores output

All enrichments are included in the merged-risk-scores output for display purposes,
but only valid scores (malicious, suspicious, benign) contribute to the final
turbine-risk-score calculation.
"""

import json
from decimal import Decimal

# Mapping of threat intelligence verdicts to numeric scores
# Scores range from 0 (benign) to 2 (malicious)
# None values indicate verdicts that are excluded from final score calculation
# but still included in merged-risk-scores output for display
score_mapping = {
    "malicious": 2,
    "suspicious": 1,
    "benign": 0,
    "unknown": None,  # Excluded from calculation, included in output
    "error": None     # Excluded from calculation, included in output
}

# Array to store all score calculation elements
# Each element represents a threat intelligence verdict with its metadata
score_calc = []

# ============================================================================
# PROVIDER WEIGHT CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

# Extract provider weights from threat_intelligence_providers configuration
# This creates a lookup dictionary: provider_name -> weight
provider_weights = {}
for provider in action_inputs.get('threat_intelligence_providers', []):
    provider_name = provider.get('Name', '')
    provider_weight = provider.get('Weight', 0)
    provider_weights[provider_name] = provider_weight

# Get default weight to use when a provider is not found in the configuration
# This ensures all enrichments have a weight, even if the provider isn't explicitly configured
default_weight = 0
for provider in action_inputs.get('threat_intelligence_providers', []):
    if provider.get('Name') == 'Default':
        default_weight = provider.get('Weight', 0)
        break

# ============================================================================
# SCORE PROCESSING FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

def process(name, value, max_value, weight, description, data_type, verdict):
    """
    Add a score element to the score_calc array.
    
    Args:
        name: Name of the score element (typically provider name)
        value: Numeric score value (0-2 for threat intelligence)
        max_value: Maximum possible value for this score type (2 for threat intelligence)
        weight: Weight multiplier for this provider's contribution
        description: Human-readable description of the score
        data_type: Type of enrichment (e.g., 'reputation', 'malware', etc.)
    """
    score_calc.append(
        {
            "name": name,
            "value": value,
            "max_value": max_value,
            "weight": weight,
            "description": description,
            "type": data_type,
            "verdict": verdict
        }
    )

for enrichment in enrichments:

    # Get weight for this provider, or use default weight if provider not found
    weight = provider_weights.get(provider_name, default_weight)
    
    # Map verdict string to numeric score value
    # Returns None for 'unknown' or 'error' verdicts, or if verdict is not in mapping
    # If verdict is empty or not found, score_value will be None
    # ALL enrichments are processed and included in merged-risk-scores output
    score_value = score_mapping.get(verdict)  # Returns None if verdict not in mapping
    
    # Process ALL enrichments (including None values) for display in merged-risk-scores

    # This ensures ALL enrichments are included in the output, regardless of verdict value
    process(name, score_value, max_value, weight, description, data_type, verdict)

# SCORE NORMALIZATION FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

def get_merged_scores():
    """
    Retrieve all score calculation elements.
    
    Returns:
        List of score dictionaries containing all processed enrichments
    """
    return score_calc


def normalize_score(value, max_value, max_normalized_value):
    """
    Normalize a score to a given maximum value using cross multiplication.
    
    Formula: normalized = (value * max_normalized_value) / max_value
    
    Args:
        value: The score value to normalize
        max_value: The maximum possible value for the input score
        max_normalized_value: The maximum value for the normalized output (e.g., 1000)
    
    Returns:
        Normalized score value, rounded to nearest integer
    """
    if max_value > 0:
        normalized_value = round((value * max_normalized_value) / max_value)
    else:
        normalized_value = 0
    return normalized_value


def get_normalized_score():
    """
    Calculate the final normalized risk score (0-1000) from all enrichments.
    
    The calculation process:
    1. For each score with a valid value (not None), calculate weighted_value = (value / max_value) * weight
    2. Sum all weighted_values to get total_value (excluding None values)
    3. Sum all weights for valid scores to get total_max_value
    4. Normalize total_value/total_max_value to a 0-1000 scale
    
    Note: Scores with None values (unknown/error) are excluded from the calculation
    but still included in the processed_scores output for display purposes.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (normalized_score, processed_scores):
        - normalized_score: Final risk score (0-1000) or None if all enrichments are unknown/error
        - processed_scores: List of detailed score breakdowns for ALL enrichments (including None values)
    """
    scores = get_merged_scores()
    
    # Handle empty scores case - return zero score with empty breakdown
    if not scores:
        return (0, [])
    
    # Calculate weighted contributions from scores with valid values (exclude None)
    # Only scores with non-None values contribute to the final risk score
    # IMPORTANT: All scores (including None values) will be included in the output
    total_value = 0      # Sum of all weighted score values (excluding None)
    total_max_value = 0  # Sum of all weights for valid scores (used as denominator for normalization)
    
    # First pass: Initialize weighted_value for all scores and calculate totals for valid scores
    for score in scores:
        weight = score.get('weight', 0)
        max_value = score.get('max_value', 0)
        value = score.get('value')
        verdict = score.get('verdict')
        
        # Handle scores with None values - they don't contribute to the final score
        # but MUST be included in the output for display
        if value is None:
            score['weighted_value'] = None  # Explicitly mark as excluded from calculation
            # Continue to next score - this one won't affect the final score calculation
            continue
        
        # Calculate weighted value: normalize score to 0-1, then multiply by weight
        # This gives each provider's contribution proportional to its weight
        if max_value > 0:
            weighted_value = (value / max_value) * weight
        else:
            weighted_value = 0
        
        # Add to totals only for valid (non-None) scores
        total_value += weighted_value
        total_max_value += weight
        score['weighted_value'] = weighted_value  # Store for later use in breakdown

    # Normalize the total weighted score to 0-1000 scale
    # This is the final risk score (only includes valid scores, excludes None values)
    if total_max_value > 0:
        normalized_value = normalize_score(total_value, total_max_value, 1000)
    else:
        # If no valid scores (all enrichments are unknown/error), return None
        # This indicates that no valid threat intelligence data was available
        normalized_value = None

    # Build detailed breakdown of each score element for output
    # CRITICAL: Include ALL scores (even those with None values) for display in merged-risk-scores
    # This ensures the table shows all enrichments, regardless of whether they contribute to the score
    processed_scores = []
    for score in scores:
        # Process every single score - no filtering or exclusion here
        new_score = {}
        weight = score.get('weight', 0)
        value = score.get('value')  # May be None for unknown/error/unmapped verdicts
        weighted_value = score.get('weighted_value')  # Will be None if value was None
        max_value = score.get('max_value', 0)
        verdict = score.get('verdict')
        
        # Format score details for output - include all fields for all scores
        new_score['Value'] = value  # May be None for unknown/error verdicts
        new_score['Max Value'] = max_value
        new_score['Weight'] = weight
        new_score['Turbine Risk Score Element Name'] = score['name']
        new_score['Description'] = score['description']
        new_score['Type'] = score['type']
        
        # Format raw score display - handle None values gracefully
        if value is not None:
            # new_score['Raw Score'] = f"{value}/{max_value}"
            new_score['Raw Score'] = verdict
        else:
            new_score['Raw Score'] = "N/A"
        
        # Normalize each individual weighted value to 0-1000 for comparison
        # Scores with None values will have None for normalized score (excluded from calculation)
        if weighted_value is not None and total_max_value > 0:
            new_score['Normalized Score'] = normalize_score(
                weighted_value, total_max_value, 1000)
        else:
            new_score['Normalized Score'] = None  # Excluded from calculation but included in output
        
        # Append ALL scores to the output list - no exceptions
        processed_scores.append(new_score)

    return (normalized_value, processed_scores)

# ============================================================================
# CALCULATE FINAL SCORES
# ============================================================================

# Calculate the final normalized risk score and detailed breakdown
normalized_score, merged_scores = get_normalized_score()


def calculate_risk_verdict(score, thresholds):
    """
    Calculate the risk verdict based on the normalized score and thresholds.
    
    Args:
        score: The normalized risk score (0-1000) or None if all enrichments are unknown/error
        thresholds: Dictionary with threshold values for Malicious, Suspicious, and Benign
    
    Returns:
        String verdict: "Malicious", "Suspicious", "Benign", or "Unknown"
    """
    # If score is None, all enrichments were unknown/error - return "Unknown"
    if score is None:
        return "Unknown"
    
    malicious_threshold = thresholds.get('Malicious', 600)
    suspicious_threshold = thresholds.get('Suspicious', 300)
    benign_threshold = thresholds.get('Benign', 0)
    
    # Determine verdict based on score thresholds (highest to lowest)
    if score >= malicious_threshold:
        return "Malicious"
    elif score >= suspicious_threshold:
        return "Suspicious"
    elif score >= benign_threshold:
        return "Benign"
    else:
        return "Unknown"


# Get thresholds from action_inputs
thresholds = action_inputs.get('turbine_risk_score_thresholds', {
    'Malicious': 600,
    'Suspicious': 300,
    'Benign': 0
})

# Calculate the risk verdict based on the normalized score
risk_verdict = calculate_risk_verdict(normalized_score, thresholds)

# will be included in the merged-risk-scores output
action_outputs = {
    # JSON string of all score elements with detailed breakdown
    # Includes ALL scores, even those with None values (unknown/error verdicts)
    'merged-risk-scores': json.dumps(merged_scores, indent=2),
    # Final normalized risk score (0-1000) or None if all enrichments are unknown/error
    'turbine-risk-score': normalized_score,
    # Risk verdict based on score thresholds: "Malicious", "Suspicious", "Benign", or "Unknown"
    'risk-score-verdict': risk_verdict,
}
